caption: Lanterna di Genova, Genoa
composition: Historic harbor lighthouse above the port · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The camera looks across the harbor toward the Lanterna, its tall lantern lit atop the rocky point on the left. To the right the port stretches with cranes, warehouses and the city's lights along the waterfront, backed by the hills. The 07:07 sky is still dusky, pink at the horizon, with the water mirroring the lights.
